instances.claim: This tells me that CENTS consists of a specific bounded collection of cents — a fixed set of objects, all identical when they started, each one since handled and marked.
instances.why: "Every Cent" and "Each object, initially identical" are claims about the membership of a population, but the only collection the draft ever introduces is the 500 billion Lincoln cents of line 6, of which neither claim could be true; the project's own set of cents, its size and its fixed membership, is never established, so both quantifiers range over a collection that exists nowhere in the piece.
